file_id: Kc Britannia Industries Limited vs Learned Adjudicating Officer on 22 June, 2017

sentences.text:
Kc Britannia Industries Limited vs Learned Adjudicating Officer
on 22 June, 2017

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
Kc Britannia Industries Limited Vs. Learned Adjudicating Officer, Kolkata & Ors.

Mr. Pratap
Chatterjee Mr. Soumabho Ghosh Mr. Dipan Sarkar Mr. Joydeep Guha.
... for the petitioner.
Mr. P. K. Sen Mr. S. K. Mishra.
... for the Union of India.
Mr. Alok Ghosh Ms. Era Ghosh.
... for the Kmc.
Mr. Amitesh Banerjee Mr. Tarak Karan.
... for the State.
The petitioner assails an order passed under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Learned senior advocate for the petitioner submits that, his client has been advised to apply for an amendment of the writ petition.
He seeks an adjournment for such purpose.

He also submits that,
the State is a necessary and proper party.
The State has been issued a notice.
He submits that, his client will take appropriate steps in the matter.
The Corporation is represented.

The learned advocate appearing for the Corporation submits that,
the point of maintainability of the writ petition be kept open.
In such circumstances, list the writ petition on July 18, 2017 under the same heading for further consideration.
